Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Welcome to the Nom Nom fam—happy to walk you through it! Here’s a simple roadmap:

Start a trial: Sign up and we’ll build a personalized 2‑week meal plan based on your dog’s info and activity level.
Transition slowly: Mix Nom Nom with current food over about a week to avoid tummy upset.
Check portions: In your account’s Pets page, use the Feeding Guide for exact portions.
Manage your plan: From your account you can tweak recipes, delivery schedule, and payment anytime before the order deadline.
Unpack & store: Let any dry ice fully vanish in a ventilated area, don’t touch it, then move meals to the freezer and keep a couple in the fridge to serve.
Try samples first (optional): You can test recipes via our Variety Pack on Chewy/Amazon or single packs at PetSmart before starting a full subscription.

So in short, you’ll: set up your dog’s profile, start the 2‑week trial, transition gradually, and use your online account to manage everything. When you’re ready, we’ll keep the meals coming every 4 weeks on a subscription basis.

Can you explain the main options in simple terms?

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Here’s a quick, plain‑English rundown of your main options with us:

Manage your subscription: Change what’s in your order, where/when it’s delivered, and view payments in your account settings.
Customize meals: On the Pets page, you can edit recipes, rotation style, portion size (full or half), and how many meal packs per day.
Check feeding instructions: Each dog has a Feeding Guide so you always know how much to serve.
Adjust for your dog’s lifestyle: Set their activity level (Average, Active, Athlete) so portions fit how much they actually move.
Add extras: From the Extras page, add treats and probiotics either one‑time or in every box.
Add or remove dogs: You can add new pups yourself; removing a dog needs help from our team and will change your pricing.
Start with a trial: New subscribers begin with a two‑week trial, then orders ship every four weeks unless you change or cancel before the deadline.
Sample without subscribing: You can buy Variety Packs or single packs through Chewy, Amazon, or PetSmart if you just want to test recipes first.
Understand cost: Pricing depends on each dog’s details (age, weight, goals, activity, recipes, and your ZIP for tax).
